caption: The drawing depicts a single, ornate, metallic object, likely made of silver or a similar material, standing upright against a plain, light background. The object has a tall, tapering cylindrical shape with a wider, rounded base that flares outward. The surface of the object is decorated with elaborate embossed patterns, including swirling motifs and floral elements. There are two rings attached to small loops positioned around the neck and midsection of the object. The top of the object has a slightly flared lip with additional decorative detail, and a thumbpiece is visible on the upper rim. The object has a metallic sheen, with areas of light and shadow carefully rendered to give a three-dimensional appearance. The artist's signature, "F. Hastings," appears in the bottom right corner. The overall color palette consists of various shades of grey, reflecting the metallic nature of the object, while the background remains a light, neutral color.
title: Fireman's Trumpet
